tools.name: save_response
tools.description: Saves a patient response and returns the next question. This function should be called after a response is recorded to save it. Calling this function multiple times for the same linkId will override the answer value. The expected answer format depends on the question type: 'choice' questions expect a descriptive code string from the provided options; 'open-choice' questions accept either a code or free text; 'integer' questions expect a whole number within the specified min/max range; 'decimal' questions expect a number (may include decimals) within the specified range; 'string' and 'text' questions expect free text respecting any maxLength constraint; 'date' questions expect a date string (YYYY-MM-DD); 'boolean' questions expect a string 'true' or 'false'.

answer.description: The patient's answer. Use a string for choice codes, free text, dates, and booleans. Use a number (integer or decimal) for numeric questions. A `null` value must ONLY be used if the patient explicitly asks to skip the question or clearly states they do not have the information. Never use `null` because of silence, filler words, or unclear responses.
